commits.author: Alex
commits.subject: replace_address: create stress schema before background workload test_replace_with_background_workload starts cassandra-stress in a background thread and polls keyspace1.standard1 for its first write. On slow debug runs, the poll can race table registration across shards and fail with no_such_column_family or ReadFail. Create the cassandra-stress-compatible schema before starting the workload. Concurrent schema creation is unrelated to the replacement scenario, so this removes the setup race without reducing coverage of background writes during replacement.
